references.text: The first census of the tribe of Gad showed the same number: 45,650 men. This verse refers to the same census that was conducted earlier.
The tribe of Gad is mentioned in the same context of the camp arrangement around the tabernacle, as part of Reuben's camp on the south side.
The second census of the tribe of Gad in the plains of Moab shows a change in number from the first census.
Gad's sons are listed when Jacob and his family went to Egypt, showing the origin of the tribe.
